hooks.command: $out = & './scripts/lint.ps1' 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($code -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine(($out | Out-String)); [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Commit BLOCKED: scripts/lint.ps1 failed. CI runs these same two gates (ruff check . + ruff format --check .) and will fail. Fix with: python -m ruff format .   then re-run scripts/lint.ps1 and retry the commit.'); exit 2 }
